entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: An Abzan rebel warrior stripped of her place by Dromoka, who wields the sword Heartsblood and trains a captured loyalist girl.

entities.name: Vasi
entities.description: A gifted young loyalist girl captured by the rebels, who trains with Felothar and learns to commune with the ancestors.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dragonlord who rules the Abzan, separates children from their families and declared the Kin-Trees blasphemous.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: A figure who discovered and bonded with a Kin-Tree, proving Dromoka's lie, and died for it.

entities.name: Bara
entities.description: Vasi's ward-sister, small and picked on, from the crèche where Vasi was raised.

entities.name: Heartsblood
entities.description: Felothar's sword, which she gives to Vasi.

entities.name: The Kin-Tree
entities.description: A burned stump with golden new growth through which the ancestors speak and to which kin bind themselves by blood.

entities.name: The Ancestors
entities.description: The spirits of the Abzan dead who guide and strengthen their descendants through the Kin-Trees.

entities.name: The Abzan
entities.description: The clan that stands together as a shield wall and that once communed with its ancestors.

entities.name: The Rebels
entities.description: Abzan dissenters opposing Dromoka who raid her garrison and tend the Kin-Tree.

entities.name: Dromoka's Loyalists
entities.description: The forces loyal to Dromoka, weakened by the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: The Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that devastated Dromoka's forces.

entities.name: The Mobile Garrison
entities.description: A desert camp of loyalists that the rebels attack at dusk.

entities.name: The Rebel Caverns
entities.description: The caverns where the rebels camp and train.

entities.name: Spirit Warriors
entities.description: Semi-transparent figures in ancient Abzan armor that Vasi calls from the sand.

events.summary: The rebels attack the mobile garrison at dusk, with Felothar leading the charge.
events.quote: The rebels fall upon the mobile garrison at dusk, sweeping in from the desert with the sun at their backs.

events.summary: Felothar defeats and spares an unarmed young man who yields.
events.quote: Terror in his eyes, the boy does so. She leaves him be.

events.summary: Felothar kills two honor guards outside a tent, after they call her a traitor.
events.quote: He's talented, well-trained, but injured and now alone. Felothar makes short work of him.

events.summary: Inside the tent, Felothar finds the girl Vasi and duels her, and Felothar ends up pinning her at sword point.
events.quote: "Fair enough," the girl pants. "My name is Vasi."

events.summary: Felothar offers to train Vasi instead of killing her, and they swear oaths: Felothar to train her, Vasi not to escape until they duel.
events.quote: "Instead, I'll make you an offer. I'll train you."

events.summary: Vasi swears by Dromoka's love not to escape until they have dueled.
events.quote: I swear by Dromoka's love that I will not attempt to escape until we've dueled.

events.summary: A month into Vasi's training, Felothar spars with her in the caverns, corners her and teaches a lesson about terrain.
events.quote: She pivots and knocks the blade from Vasi's hand, then puts the flat of her blade to the girl's neck.

events.summary: Vasi mentions her ward-sister, then angrily changes the subject.
events.quote: "My ward-sister always said the terrain makes the battle."

events.summary: At the Kin-Tree Felothar explains why the ancestors matter and how Anafenza showed Dromoka's claim to be a lie.
events.quote: Anafenza proved that to be a lie when she discovered and bonded with one.

events.summary: Felothar reveals her chosen family and how the ancestors shaped her, and Vasi tells of her ward-sister Bara.
events.quote: But one, Bara, we were … like sisters.

events.summary: Vasi asks whether the rebels can truly stand against Dromoka, and Felothar admits she has doubts but will walk her path.
events.quote: "My path is set," Felothar says at last, "and I will walk it.

events.summary: Vasi confronts Felothar after learning she plans to lead an attack and refuses to tell her.
events.quote: "You swore to me!" Vasi's words echo through the cavern.

events.summary: Vasi leaves the camp while Felothar attends the war council.
events.quote: Only later does she realize what her apprentice was truly asking for, and by that time, Vasi is already gone.

events.summary: Felothar finds Vasi on a mountain path and they fight in the dark.
events.quote: "So did you," she says and lunges forward.

events.summary: Vasi summons two ancestor spirits from the sand and defeats Felothar, but spares her.
events.quote: the sand beside her shifts, coalescing into two figures clad in ancient Abzan armor, semi-transparent in the starlight.

events.summary: Vasi explains that she offered her blood to the Kin-Tree and was told where to find her ward-sister Bara.
events.quote: "Looking for Bara, my ward-sister," Vasi says.

events.summary: Felothar gives Vasi Heartsblood and Vasi goes with her spirit escort to find Bara.
events.quote: "Take Heartsblood," she says, "May it see you safely to your goals."

events.summary: Felothar heads back to the rebel encampment as the camp prepares to depart for battle against Dromoka's forces.
events.quote: she does know that her family is stronger than Dromoka imagines.

relations.note: Dromoka stripped Felothar of her place and ordered her execution.
relations.quote: The last time was when the dragonlord stripped her of her place and ordered her execution.
Felothar leads the charge, her sword, Heartsblood, severing limbs and slicing throats.

relations.note: Vasi begins as a loyalist swearing by Dromoka's love.
relations.quote: "I'm loyal to Dromoka, traitor," Vasi says.

relations.note: They were like sisters, ward-sisters from the crèche.
relations.quote: Like I imagine real sisters would be.

relations.note: Anafenza discovered and bonded with a Kin-Tree, at the cost of her life.
relations.quote: The discovery cost Anafenza her life, but the seeds of rebellion had already been planted.

relations.note: Felothar wields Heartsblood and later gives it to Vasi.
relations.quote: her sword, Heartsblood, severing limbs and slicing throats
